data.name: Benjamin
data.gender_notes: Benjamin is used as a male name in christian naming traditions.
data.short_meaning: Son of the right hand; son of the south
data.long_meaning: From the Hebrew Binyamin: ben, 'son', + yamin, 'right hand' or 'south'. Its root is Hebrew b-n + y-m-y-n. Benjamin, son of Jacob (Genesis 35:18). Benjamin is a Hebrew name meaning “Son of the right hand; son of the south”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses.
data.spiritual_meaning: Benjamin expresses “Son of the right hand; son of the south”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.etymology: From the Hebrew Binyamin: ben, 'son', + yamin, 'right hand' or 'south'.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Benjamin total 32, reducing to 5. Number 5 is associated with freedom, adaptability and curiosity.
